test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the Economic Survey, 2020, how many banks of India are there in the list of the top global 100?
solution:
The correct answer is __**One**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per the Economic Survey, 2020, **Only one bank in India** are there on the list of the **top global 100.**
 
• India being the fifth largest economy, India should have at least six banks in the top 100 global list, and at least eight would be required for a country having a $5-trillion economy.
 
• Chief Economic Adviser-K V Subramanian said (in 2020) that India needs more global-sized banks to help the country achieve a $5 trillion economy by 2024-25.
 
• State Bank of India (SBI) at the 55th position is the only bank on the global top 100 list.
 
• China has 18 banks while the US has 12 on the list.
